# Lababacy Apps

> Practical, privacy-first apps for iPhone and Android by an independent developer. Every app works entirely on-device: your files are never uploaded, and there is no account. The flagship product is Database Viewer, which opens Microsoft Access (MDB/ACCDB), SQLite, Excel, OpenDocument, dBase and plain-text data files right on a phone — a native C engine for large files, a health check for every file, free to start with a one-time Pro upgrade.

## Apps

- [Database Viewer: SQLite & DBF](https://lababacy.com/databaseviewer/): Open MDB/ACCDB (Microsoft Access), SQLite, XLSX, XLSM, ODS, DBF, CSV, TSV and SQL dump files on Android and iPhone. Native C engine, health check before you open, nothing uploaded. Free tier available (ad-supported); Pro is a one-time purchase that removes ads.
- [Access Database Viewer: MDB AI](https://lababacy.com/access_db_viewer/): Open and inspect Microsoft Access (MDB/ACCDB) databases on iPhone, on-device.
- [Winmail Reader - DAT, MSG, EML](https://lababacy.com/winmail/): Open winmail.dat (TNEF), MSG, OFT, EML, MHT, XPS, MBOX, PST, OST and OLM files on iPhone and iPad, decoded on-device. Free to look inside (first screen of a message, attachment list, archive folder tree with a preview of its first messages); a one-time purchase unlocks full reading, attachment extraction, full archive browsing, exports and search. No account, no uploads.
- [Publisher File Viewer](https://lababacy.com/pubview/): Open Microsoft Publisher .pub files on iPhone and iPad with the original layout preserved.
- [Shift: Contact Export & Backup](https://lababacy.com/shift/): Export contacts to VCF, CSV, XLSX or an encrypted local backup.
- [VoxMail - Speak to Text Email](https://lababacy.com/voxmail/): Record a voice note, transcribe it on-device, and send it as a finished email.
- [Masked: Redact PDF & Photos](https://lababacy.com/masked/): Remove sensitive faces, text and metadata from photos and PDFs before sharing.
- [WholeNote: Export Notes](https://lababacy.com/note2poster/): Turn Apple Notes into complete, searchable PDFs and long images.
- [MemoSnap: Lock Screen Todo](https://lababacy.com/memosnap/): To-dos and memo wallpapers on the lock screen.
- [NoNag: Block Open in App](https://lababacy.com/nonag/): A Safari extension that dismisses "Open in App" banners and redirect pop-ups.
- [WallDone: Visual To-Do List](https://lababacy.com/walldone/): A calm, visual to-do list of finished tasks on your wall.

## Database Viewer — formats & guides

- [Formats index](https://lababacy.com/formats/) — every file format Database Viewer opens on Android and iPhone, with a guide per format.
- [MDB Viewer](https://lababacy.com/formats/mdb-viewer/) — open legacy Microsoft Access databases (Jet 3/4) on Android and iPhone, on-device.
- [ACCDB Viewer](https://lababacy.com/formats/accdb-viewer/) — open Access 2007 and later databases without Microsoft Access.
- [MDB to CSV](https://lababacy.com/formats/mdb-to-csv/) — convert Access tables to CSV, or the whole database to one XLSX workbook, on the phone.
- [DBF Viewer](https://lababacy.com/formats/dbf-viewer/) — open dBASE tables and shapefile attribute data on Android and iPhone.
- [SQLite Viewer](https://lababacy.com/formats/sqlite-viewer/) — browse SQLite databases, inspect the schema and run SQL on the phone.
- [ODS Viewer](https://lababacy.com/formats/ods-viewer/) — open OpenDocument spreadsheets (LibreOffice/OpenOffice) without LibreOffice or Excel.

## Winmail Reader — formats & guides

- [Formats index](https://lababacy.com/winmail/formats/) — every legacy email format the app opens on iPhone and iPad.
- [winmail.dat / TNEF](https://lababacy.com/winmail/formats/winmail-dat/) — what Outlook's TNEF wrapper is and how to open it on iPhone without Outlook.
- MSG, EML, MHT, MBOX, PST/OST, OLM and XPS hub pages are published one per day under https://lababacy.com/winmail/formats/ — this list is updated as each goes live.
- Guides are published under https://lababacy.com/winmail/guides/ as they are finished.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Free tier wording: "free to look inside" — first screen of a message, first page of an XPS document, attachment list, archive folder tree with a preview of the first messages. Full reading, extraction, exports, search and resending are part of the one-time Pro purchase.
- Privacy: decoding runs on-device; files are never uploaded and no account is required. Do not claim "zero data collection" — crash diagnostics are collected.
- Platforms: Winmail Reader is iOS/iPadOS only (iOS 17.0+). Database Viewer is Android and iOS.
